title: "Quarto syntax"
description: "The handful of Quarto features this site uses, with copy-paste examples."
order: 1
engine: markdown
---

Everything here is regular Markdown plus a few Quarto additions. Each example shows the source, then what it looks like.

## Callouts

Five types: `note`, `tip`, `warning`, `important`, `caution`.

````markdown
::: {.callout-tip}
## Label tubes before grinding
Marker rubs off once tubes are frozen.
:::
````

::: {.callout-tip}
## Label tubes before grinding
Marker rubs off once tubes are frozen.
:::

Add `collapse="true"` to make one that starts folded:

````markdown
::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Why we do it this way
Background that most readers can skip.
:::
````

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Why we do it this way
Background that most readers can skip.
:::

## Tabs

Good for instructions that differ by operating system or by crop.

````markdown
::: {.panel-tabset}
## Windows
Use WinSCP.

## macOS / Linux
Use rclone.
:::
````

::: {.panel-tabset}
## Windows
Use WinSCP.

## macOS / Linux
Use rclone.
:::

## Code blocks

Name the language for syntax highlighting. Add a `filename` when it helps.

````markdown
```{.bash filename="Terminal"}
sbatch run_calling.sh
```
````

```{.bash filename="Terminal"}
sbatch run_calling.sh
```

## Links between pages

Link to the `.qmd` file with a relative path. Quarto turns it into the right web address.

```markdown
See [Nextcloud](../computing/nextcloud.qmd).
Jump to a heading: [shared/geno layout](../computing/hpc.qmd#sharedgeno-layout).
```

## Images

```markdown
![Seed chipping setup](images/seed-chipping.jpg){fig-alt="Razor blade, cutting surface, and labeled 2 mL tubes on a bench" width="70%"}
```

The text in `[ ]` is the caption. `fig-alt` is read by screen readers, so describe what is in the picture.

## Diagrams

Quarto draws [Mermaid](https://mermaid.js.org/) diagrams from plain text.

````markdown
```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  A[Harvest] --> B[Weigh] --> C[NIR scan] --> D[Upload]
```
````

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  A[Harvest] --> B[Weigh] --> C[NIR scan] --> D[Upload]
```

## Running R code

A chunk with `{r}` runs when the page renders and shows its output. Remove `engine: markdown` from the page header if you add one, and commit `_freeze/` afterwards (see [Contributing](index.qmd#pages-that-run-code)).

````markdown
```{r}
#| label: fig-yield
#| fig-cap: "Fruit weight by entry"
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(pheno, aes(entry, fruit_wt)) + geom_boxplot()
```
````

To show R code without running it, leave off the braces: ```` ```r ````.
